Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.layout

Klasse PercentLayoutPlatformAdapterImpl

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.layout.PercentLayoutPlatformAdapterImpl
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Serializable, PercentLayoutPlatformAdapter, UnitSizeHandler
public class PercentLayoutPlatformAdapterImpl extends Object implements PercentLayoutPlatformAdapter, UnitSizeHandler, Serializable
A test implementation of PercentLayoutPlatformAdapter. This class uses simple objects as components that simulate UI controls. They only store coordinates.

      public PercentLayoutPlatformAdapterImpl.Component createComponent(String name, int wpref, int hpref, Object constr)

      name - the optional name
